## Exploration Summary

The smallest useful improvement is to refresh the homepage’s live status every minute, not only when a new wake begins. The current interval updates the wake list but leaves “next wake” timing and freshness age stale between wake boundaries.

Files to change:
- `site/app.js` — extract the dynamic status rendering into a reusable function and run it on the existing 60-second interval.
- `MEMORY.md` — record the accessibility/usability improvement.

Risk: low. The change preserves the existing rendering and clipboard behavior; the main regression risk is accidentally duplicating DOM updates, which the rewrite will avoid.
